scientific_question: Does the frozen A2 region provide value beyond a single A2-centre point warm start?
Does the frozen A2 region provide value beyond a generic 16-point global initialization?

DDS_GLOBAL.definition: standard sequential DDS over complete formal normalized [0,1]^14

DDS_SOFT_AI.definition: evaluation 1 frozen A2 centre; evaluations 2-16 frozen A2-region samples; evaluation 17 onward standard sequential DDS over complete formal normalized [0,1]^14

DDS_HARD_AI.use: auxiliary explanation; not pooled with the ten-seed confirmatory comparisons
DDS_HARD_AI.interpretation: hard restriction can suppress global correction

DDS_POINT_AI.evaluation_2_to_250: standard sequential DDS over complete formal normalized [0,1]^14
DDS_POINT_AI.interpretation: AI point prior to global DDS

DDS_RANDOM_SOFT.evaluation_1_to_16: deterministic scrambled Sobol design, 16 points, 14 dimensions, seed equal to paired seed, normalized [0,1]^14 then mapped to complete formal bounds
DDS_RANDOM_SOFT.evaluation_17_to_250: standard sequential DDS over complete formal normalized [0,1]^14 using the best development objective among evaluations 1-16 as incumbent

fairness.objective: A5 formal development objective: three-station mean NSE

anytime_auc.curve: development best-so-far mean NSE at every evaluation 1-250

primary_metrics.paired_statistics: ten paired seeds; mean, median, sample standard deviation, paired delta, deterministic bootstrap 95% CI, and wins/ties

REGION_GUIDANCE_VALUE.CONFIRMED: SOFT_AI minus POINT_AI paired AUC mean > 0 and bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
REGION_GUIDANCE_VALUE.SUPPORTED: paired AUC mean > 0 and bootstrap 95% CI crosses 0

AI_INFORMATION_VALUE.CONFIRMED: SOFT_AI minus RANDOM_SOFT paired AUC mean > 0 and bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
AI_INFORMATION_VALUE.SUPPORTED: paired AUC mean > 0 and bootstrap 95% CI crosses 0

causal_decisions.POINT_WARMSTART_VALUE: report DDS_POINT_AI minus DDS_GLOBAL paired AUC and final-best comparison; do not use this comparison to retune any arm
causal_decisions.soft_ai_final_no_stable_degradation: paired final-best mean delta is not below -0.005 and its bootstrap 95% CI is not wholly below zero

ABLATION_RESULT.STRONG: REGION_GUIDANCE_VALUE=CONFIRMED and AI_INFORMATION_VALUE=CONFIRMED and SOFT_AI 250-evaluation final accuracy has no stable degradation
ABLATION_RESULT.PARTIAL: at least one of the two values is CONFIRMED, or both are SUPPORTED

recovery_and_integrity.resume_protocol: formal ledger-only deterministic no-SWAT replay; never rerun completed evaluations
